# Full Workflow — init → write → read → append → search → lint → approve → delete

# === INIT ===
exec akb init workflow-kb
cd workflow-kb

# === WRITE ===
stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write workflow-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/workflow-note.md'
exists kb/notes/workflow-note.md

# === READ ===
exec akb read notes/workflow-note.md
stdout 'Full Workflow Note'
stdout 'This is a draft note'
stdout 'olw-auto'
stdout '\^\[inferred\]'

# === APPEND ===
stdin ../append-input.md
exec akb append notes/workflow-note.md
stdout 'Appended to kb/notes/workflow-note.md'

# === READ AFTER APPEND ===
exec akb read notes/workflow-note.md
stdout 'Appended content for the workflow test.'

# === SEARCH ===
exec akb search 'workflow test'
stdout 'notes/workflow-note.md'

# === LINT ===
# Single page will have orphans, but lint should run successfully
exec akb lint
stdout 'orphans'
stdout 'issue\(s\) found'

# === APPROVE ===
exec akb approve notes/workflow-note.md
stdout 'Approved ''notes/workflow-note.md'''

# === READ AFTER APPROVE ===
exec akb read notes/workflow-note.md
stdout 'is_draft: false'
! stdout 'olw-auto'
! stdout '\^\[inferred\]'

# === DELETE ===
exec akb delete notes/workflow-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/workflow-note.md'
! exists kb/notes/workflow-note.md

# === SEARCH AFTER DELETE ===
exec akb search 'workflow test'
! stdout .

# === STATUS ===
exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 0'

# === GIT HISTORY ===
exec git log --oneline
stdout 'akb: delete kb/notes/workflow-note.md'
stdout 'akb: approve notes/workflow-note.md'
stdout 'akb: append kb/notes/workflow-note.md'
stdout 'akb: write kb/notes/workflow-note.md'
stdout 'akb: init workflow-kb'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Full Workflow Note
summary: Testing the complete workflow
tags: workflow
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
This is a draft note with annotations.
<!-- olw-auto: action=review -->
^[inferred] This is an inferred claim.
More content here.

-- append-input.md --
Appended content for the workflow test.
